name: file-previewer
title: File Previewer
description: Inline preview for uploaded files — images, video, audio, office documents, and archives — with a typed-icon fallback for non-previewable types. Wraps @cyntler/react-doc-viewer. For PDFs prefer the pdf-viewer component.
docs: Import { FilePreviewer } from '@/components/ui/file-previewer'. Pass file URLs (Blocks fileDataBlock redirect URLs are handled). The container must have a defined height.

changelog.description: Brings the app's copy up to date and adds its version line.
